# Daiana Laura Rodriguez – Senior Product Designer

> AI-driven Senior Product Designer based in Lisbon, with 10+ years of experience creating meaningful digital experiences for brands like Dremio, Dell Technologies and Burger King.

## About
- Currently at Dremio (data lakehouse platform), using behavioural analytics to drive the design of the company website.
- Previously led product design for the Dell Design System website at Dell Technologies, working with a team of four designers.
- Uses AI throughout the design process: Contentsquare AI analytics, Claude Design, Figma Make and Weavy.
- Completed six UX courses with the Nielsen Norman Group.
- Fluent in Spanish, English, Italian and Portuguese; currently learning Japanese.

## Case studies
- [Optimizing Dremio's Website Through Analytics & AI](https://portfolio-daiana-belcastro.vercel.app/Dremio.html): homepage, pricing and performance redesign; homepage conversion nearly tripled.
- [Improving Support in DDS with AI](https://portfolio-daiana-belcastro.vercel.app/support-ai.html): Dell Design System
- [Leadership at the Dell Design System](https://portfolio-daiana-belcastro.vercel.app/Dell-case.html)
- [BK Delivery app](https://portfolio-daiana-belcastro.vercel.app/bk-delivery.html): Burger King
- [E-commerce for Masters](https://portfolio-daiana-belcastro.vercel.app/cmmg-masters.html): Medical Sciences University (CMMG)
- [Recruitment platform](https://portfolio-daiana-belcastro.vercel.app/trabajo-argentina.html): Trabajo Argentina
